Migration prefix 2026_11_27_001001 was used because the plan draft prefix 2026_11_27_000030 was not unique in this worktree. The migration is anonymous, forward-only and creates travel_request_changes plus travel_attendance_links.

TravelService is the only writer for trip status, changes and attendance links. Approval/rejection/cancellation and change application share one DB transaction; the link is a calendar fact only, never a punch, worked minute or payroll row.

Change command goes through CommandRunner with Idempotency-Key, same-transaction audit (time.travel.change_requested/applied/rejected/attendance_linked/attendance_retired) and stable 409 reasons TRAVEL_CHANGE_ALREADY_PENDING, TRAVEL_NOT_CHANGEABLE, TRAVEL_OVERLAP, TRAVEL_CASE_ALREADY_DECIDED, TRAVEL_EXPENSE_SETTLED.

Ledger filtering and reports use Time-owned tables; department expansion uses Shared PersonEmploymentDirectory in controllers and Time EmploymentDirectory in the report service, with no cross-module table access.

Frontend /travel has six tabs mine|requests|policies|approval|reports|expenses, server-side filtering, detail Drawer, policy publish, approval decisions and integer-cent expense entry. Invalid tabs fall back to mine; unconfigured policies and forbidden capability states are explicit.

Backend tests are under backend/tests/Feature/Time/Travel*Test.php; frontend tests are frontend/tests/unit/TravelWorkspace.spec.ts. Tests were written but NOT RUN. Only php -l was executed on new/changed PHP files. No PHPUnit, pnpm test:unit, typecheck, gate or E2E command was run.

The module currently ships the report tests under the existing read capability seam and does not modify IAM.
